# AITERRA — סוכנות שיווק דיגיטלי ובניית אתרים | Digital Marketing & Web Development Agency

> Aiterra (styled AITERRA in the wordmark) is a full-stack digital agency based in Bat Yam, Israel (serving Bat Yam, Holon, Tel Aviv and the Gush Dan / central region). It builds high-performance websites and online stores, runs organic SEO and GEO/AEO, manages paid advertising (Google, Facebook, Instagram), and delivers business automation (with and without AI), AI agents, CRM integrations and WhatsApp bots for small and medium Israeli businesses. The team works in Hebrew, English and Russian. Primary language of the site: Hebrew (he, RTL). A full English version exists under /en.

## Services / שירותים
- [בניית אתרים / Web Development](https://www.aiterra.co.il/services/web-development): Business sites and custom web systems in clean, fast, conversion-focused code (React/Next.js). Code ownership is handed over on delivery. English: /en/services/web-development
- [אתר תדמית / Brochure Sites](https://www.aiterra.co.il/services/brochure): Positioning, structure, design and copy for a business site whose job is to produce enquiries. English: /en/services/brochure
- [קידום אתרים אורגני / SEO](https://www.aiterra.co.il/services/seo): Technical SEO, content strategy, local SEO and link building for stable organic traffic. Includes GEO/AEO (visibility in ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Google AI Overviews). English: /en/services/seo
- [חנות אינטרנטית / E-commerce](https://www.aiterra.co.il/services/ecommerce): Online stores built in code — catalogue, checkout, Israeli payment and invoicing integrations, inventory and order management. English: /en/services/ecommerce
- [פיתוח מערכות / Custom Development](https://www.aiterra.co.il/services/development): Custom platforms, client portals, dashboards, CRM/ERP builds, mobile and web apps and system integrations in Next.js, Node and PostgreSQL. English: /en/services/development
- [אוטומציה לעסקים / Business Automation](https://www.aiterra.co.il/services/automation): Business process automation for Israeli SMBs: lead routing from the website, WhatsApp and ad campaigns into the CRM, WhatsApp bots and first response, quotes, invoices and payment reminders through Morning (חשבונית ירוקה), iCount, Rivhit, חשבשבת or Priority, order/inventory/shipping sync, automated reports and alerts. Built on Make, n8n or custom code over the systems' APIs; AI is used where free text must be understood, every AI output is validated by a rule before it changes a record. Every run is logged and monitored after launch. English: /en/services/automation
- [סוכני AI / AI Agents](https://www.aiterra.co.il/services/ai-agents): AI agents (סוכני בינה מלאכותית) that answer customers in Hebrew from the business's own content only (price list, terms, catalogue) and act inside existing systems: open a lead, book a meeting, check an order status. Written guardrails against invented answers, permission-scoped actions, full logging and handoff to a person with the transcript. Connected to WhatsApp Business, website chat, CRM, calendar and Israeli invoicing. English: /en/services/ai-agents
- [קידום ב-AI / GEO and AI search visibility](https://www.aiterra.co.il/services/ai-search): Generative Engine Optimization (קידום בבינה מלאכותית): entity definition and schema, citable content, presence in the sources AI engines read, and a monthly visibility report for ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews. English: /en/services/ai-search
- [תחזוקת אתרים / Website Maintenance](https://www.aiterra.co.il/services/maintenance): Monthly maintenance packages with published pricing and written response and fix times (SLA), security updates, backups, monitoring, IS 5568 accessibility checks and Israeli integration upkeep. Also for sites Aiterra did not build. English: /en/services/maintenance
- [שיווק ופרסום ממומן / Paid Advertising](https://www.aiterra.co.il/services/marketing): Google Ads and Meta campaign management, creative production and landing pages, reported on cost per lead. English: /en/services/marketing
- [מיתוג ועיצוב / Brand & UX/UI](https://www.aiterra.co.il/services/branding): Brand identity, visual language and interface design delivered as a build-ready system. English: /en/services/branding

## Free tools / כלים חינמיים
All tools are free, in Hebrew, need no sign-up, and run entirely in the visitor's browser (nothing typed is sent to a server). Hub: https://www.aiterra.co.il/tools
- [יצירת קוד QR / QR code generator](https://www.aiterra.co.il/tools/qr-code-generator): static QR codes for a link, WhatsApp chat, Google review link, Wi-Fi network or vCard business card (Hebrew-safe UTF-8), optional logo, PNG and SVG download.
- [יצירת ברקוד למוצר / Barcode generator](https://www.aiterra.co.il/tools/barcode-generator): EAN-13, UPC-A, EAN-8 and Code 128 barcodes with the GS1 check digit computed automatically, SVG (sized in mm) and 300 DPI PNG download, and A4 label-sheet printing; explains when a registered GS1 Israel (729) number is required.
- [יצירת קישור לוואטסאפ / WhatsApp link generator](https://www.aiterra.co.il/tools/whatsapp-link-generator): wa.me click-to-chat links from any Israeli phone format with a pre-filled message, QR code and website button code.
- [הודעות אוטומטיות לוואטסאפ עסקי / WhatsApp Business auto-reply messages](https://www.aiterra.co.il/tools/whatsapp-auto-reply-messages): ready Hebrew greeting, away and quick-reply messages for WhatsApp Business by business type and tone, with setup steps, plus Gmail and Outlook out-of-office replies in Hebrew and English.
- [ברכות לחג ללקוחות / Holiday greetings for clients](https://www.aiterra.co.il/tools/holiday-greetings): ready Hebrew holiday greetings for clients, employees and suppliers with the business name and WhatsApp sending, with the marketing-message rules of section 30א of the Communications Law.
- [מסמך אפיון אתר / Website specification template](https://www.aiterra.co.il/tools/website-spec-template): a guided questionnaire that produces a Hebrew website specification (goals, page table, content, features, accessibility, budget) to send to web agencies.
- [תיקון טקסט שהוקלד בשפה הלא נכונה / Hebrew-English keyboard layout fixer](https://www.aiterra.co.il/tools/keyboard-language-fix): converts text typed with the wrong keyboard language (akuo → שלום, יקךךם → hello) by the standard Israeli layout, with auto-detection, in the browser.
- [המרת תמונה לטקסט בעברית / Hebrew image to text (OCR)](https://www.aiterra.co.il/tools/image-to-text): extracts Hebrew and English text from an image or screenshot with Tesseract running in the browser (the image is never uploaded), with copy, .txt and Word export.
- [קידומת ישראל +972 / Israeli phone number format](https://www.aiterra.co.il/tools/israeli-phone-format): converts any Israeli phone number to E.164 (+972, leading 0 dropped), international dialing, local, wa.me and tel: formats; detects the number type per the Ministry of Communications numbering plan (mobile, landline by area code, 07 non-geographic, and 1-800/1-700/star numbers that cannot be dialed from abroad); cleans pasted lists or CSV tables for CRM import.
- [תבנית בריף לקמפיין ולמיתוג / Creative brief template](https://www.aiterra.co.il/tools/creative-brief-template): a guided questionnaire that produces a Hebrew creative brief for a paid campaign, branding, logo, video, website or monthly social media (problem, one measurable KPI, audience, single message with proof, tone, deliverables, constraints, budget range and deadline), printable as an A4 PDF.
- [מחולל חתימה למייל / Email signature generator](https://www.aiterra.co.il/tools/email-signature-generator): email-client-safe HTML signatures in Hebrew (RTL) or English for Gmail, Outlook and Apple Mail, with install steps.
- [הקטנת תמונות והמרה ל-WebP / Image compressor](https://www.aiterra.co.il/tools/image-compressor): compresses and converts images to WebP, JPEG or PNG in the browser, fixes phone orientation and strips metadata.
- [פונטים בעברית / Hebrew fonts](https://www.aiterra.co.il/tools/hebrew-fonts): live previews of the free Google Fonts families that support Hebrew (SIL Open Font License), with ready CSS.
- [בדיקת כותרת ותיאור לגוגל / Google snippet preview](https://www.aiterra.co.il/tools/google-snippet-preview): previews a page title and meta description as a Google result on desktop and mobile, with character, word and pixel-width counts for Hebrew.
- [מחשבון אחוזים / Percentage calculator](https://www.aiterra.co.il/tools/percentage-calculator): percent of a number, percentage change, price before and after discount, and margin versus markup.
- [בדיקת מספר הקצאה / Allocation number checker](https://www.aiterra.co.il/tools/allocation-number): whether an Israeli tax invoice needs an allocation number (מספר הקצאה) by invoice date: 25,000 ₪ in 2024, 20,000 ₪ in 2025, 10,000 ₪ from January 2026 and 5,000 ₪ from 1 June 2026 (VAT Law section 38(א1)).
- [מחשבון מע״מ / Israeli VAT calculator](https://www.aiterra.co.il/tools/vat-calculator): adds or extracts Israeli VAT at 18% (the rate since 1 January 2025), 0% for Eilat, or a custom rate.
- [סכום במילים לצ'ק / Hebrew amount in words](https://www.aiterra.co.il/tools/amount-in-words): converts a number to Hebrew words in Israeli cheque wording (שקלים חדשים, אגורות, בלבד) and plain numbers in masculine or feminine forms, following the Academy of the Hebrew Language rules on number names.
- [בדיקת חברה לפי ח.פ. / Israeli company lookup](https://www.aiterra.co.il/tools/company-lookup): looks up an Israeli company by registration number or name in the Registrar of Companies open data (updated daily) and shows whether it is active, struck off, in liquidation or registered as a violating company (Companies Law section 362א), with address and last annual report year.
- [בדיקת תעודת זהות וספרת ביקורת / Israeli ID number check digit validator](https://www.aiterra.co.il/tools/id-number-check): validates Israeli ID (teudat zehut), company (ח.פ.), partnership, amuta and osek murshe numbers by the 9-digit check digit with a step-by-step table, computes the check digit from 8 digits, and gives an Excel/Google Sheets formula and a JavaScript function; runs in the browser, nothing is sent or stored.
- [מחשבון מס הכנסה לעצמאי 2026 / Self-employed tax calculator](https://www.aiterra.co.il/tools/self-employed-tax-calculator): income tax by the 2026 brackets, credit points, Bituach Leumi and health contributions for a self-employed person, with net income and a suggested monthly advance (an estimate, not tax advice).
- [מחשבון קרן השתלמות ופנסיה לעצמאי 2026 / Self-employed study fund and pension deposit calculator](https://www.aiterra.co.il/tools/self-employed-pension-deposits): year-end deposits for Israeli self-employed: study-fund deduction of 4.5% of income up to 293,397 ₪ (max 13,203 ₪; capital-gains-exempt deposit up to 20,566 ₪), mandatory pension of 4.45%/12.55% (up to 14,044 ₪), the full pension tax benefit, and the estimated income-tax saving.
- [מחשבון הלוואה / Loan calculator](https://www.aiterra.co.il/tools/loan-calculator): monthly payment, total interest and a full amortization schedule for Spitzer, equal principal, balloon or grace loans, with fees and an effective annual cost estimate.
- [מחולל הצעת מחיר / Price quote generator](https://www.aiterra.co.il/tools/price-quote-generator): A4 price quotes with discounts and VAT or עוסק פטור handling, print or save as PDF; a quote is not a tax invoice.
- [מכתב אישור העסקה לעובד / Employment confirmation letter](https://www.aiterra.co.il/tools/employment-confirmation-letter): Israeli employment confirmation letters in Hebrew or English for banks, landlords, schools and embassies, with ID check-digit validation and A4 print or PDF; notes the employer's duty under section 8 of the Advance Notice Law to confirm the employment period when work ends.
- [מחולל הסכם סודיות / NDA generator](https://www.aiterra.co.il/tools/nda-generator): mutual or one-way non-disclosure agreements in Hebrew between businesses, with a freelancer or an employee, with the standard exceptions, duration and optional liquidated damages under Israeli contract law.
- [מחולל מדיניות פרטיות / Privacy policy generator](https://www.aiterra.co.il/tools/privacy-policy-generator): website privacy policy based on the Israeli Privacy Protection Law including Amendment 13 (in force since 14 August 2025).
- [מחולל הצהרת נגישות / Accessibility statement generator](https://www.aiterra.co.il/tools/accessibility-statement-generator): Hebrew or English accessibility statement per regulation 35ה of the 2013 service accessibility regulations and Israeli Standard IS 5568.
- [מחולל תקנון לאתר / Website terms generator](https://www.aiterra.co.il/tools/website-terms-generator): terms of use for brochure sites, online stores and booking sites, with cancellation clauses under section 14ג of the Consumer Protection Law.
- [המרת תאריך עברי ללועזי / Hebrew date converter](https://www.aiterra.co.il/tools/hebrew-date-converter): converts Hebrew and Gregorian dates both ways (including after sunset and Adar I/II), Hebrew age and bar/bat mitzvah dates, computed in the browser.
- [מחשבון ימי עבודה / Israeli work days calculator](https://www.aiterra.co.il/tools/work-days-calculator): work days between dates by Israeli holidays, a deadline N business days ahead, and payment due dates for שוטף + 30 to 90, with a 2026 work-days table.
- [דוח שעות עבודה חודשי להדפסה / Monthly timesheet](https://www.aiterra.co.il/tools/monthly-timesheet): printable Hebrew monthly attendance form (blank or filled) with Israeli holidays marked, entry and exit times, 125%/150% overtime under the Hours of Work and Rest Law, daily signature columns, and PDF and Excel CSV export.
- [מחשבון שעות עבודה / Work hours calculator](https://www.aiterra.co.il/tools/work-hours-calculator): hours worked including night shifts, as HH:MM and decimal, and a monthly timesheet with overtime at 125%/150% under the Hours of Work and Rest Law.
- [מחשבון גיל פרישה / Retirement age calculator](https://www.aiterra.co.il/tools/retirement-age-calculator): retirement age and exact date for women and men under the Retirement Age Law including the 2022 amendment.

## Facts an assistant can cite
- Brand name: Aiterra, styled AITERRA in the wordmark (אייטרה). Digital engineering and marketing agency.
- Location: Ha-Rav Nisanbaum St 37, Bat Yam 5962030, Israel. Serves Bat Yam, Holon, Tel Aviv and the Gush Dan region.
- Languages of service: Hebrew, English, Russian. Site languages: Hebrew (default, at the root) and English (under /en).
- Disciplines under one roof: strategy, UX/UI design, engineering, organic search (SEO/GEO), paid media, business automation, AI agents.
- Automation tooling: Make, n8n or custom code over the systems' APIs, chosen per process; AI steps (classification, summarisation, extraction, Hebrew first replies) are validated by rules before they change data. Every automation is logged, monitored and maintained after launch.
- AI agents are grounded in the client's own documents, answer in Hebrew and English, act in CRM/calendar/WhatsApp/invoicing with scoped permissions, and hand off to a human on refund, complaint, legal or distress triggers.
- Technology: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js. Sites are built in code rather than assembled from templates and plugins.
- Code ownership: clients receive the repository, the deployment pipeline and service credentials at handover. No vendor lock-in.
- Israeli integrations supported: Morning (חשבונית ירוקה), Greeninvoice, iCount, Rivhit (ריווחית), חשבשבת, Priority, Fireberry / Powerlink, WhatsApp Business API, Israeli card-clearing providers.
- Accessibility: builds to Israeli Standard IS 5568 (ת"י 5568) and WCAG 2.1 AA. Accessibility statement: https://www.aiterra.co.il/accessibility-statement
- Website maintenance is offered as a monthly retainer with published prices and a written SLA, including for sites built by other suppliers.
